Name: (CP) Mary's Cuter Dust Spirits
Author: SimplyMary
Description:
[center][size=3]I wanted to dip my toes into making Content Patcher mods and also wanted cuter dust spirits, so yeah. It's probably not perfect, but it works!

[u][b]Installation:[/b][/u]
1) Make sure you have SMAPI and Content Patcher installed
2) Download mod
3) Unzip mod
4) Drop unzipped folder " [CP] Mary's Cuter Dust Spirits " in mods folder
5) Enjoy!

[u][b]Disclaimer:[/b][/u]
This is my first time making a Content Patcher mod of my own and it's bound to have it's issues so please be patient with me! I'm learning ;-;  but I will try to fix any issues that pop up! Also I don't currently have plans for future mods but I'm definitely open to taking suggestions into consideration! (No guarantees though!)

[u][b]TOU:
[/b][/u]Feel free to do whatever as long as you credit me and link back here and don't upload on pay sites!
[/size][/center]
